title: Horned Muse by the Ruins
description: A silhouetted female figure with large curved horns sits on a moss-covered stone ledge, extending her hand toward glowing yellow cherry blossom branches. Behind her are ancient Greek temple ruins overgrown with vines, set against a swirling twilight sky filled with floating bubbles containing silhouetted couples, black birds, and scattered pink petals over reflective water.
prompt: A silhouetted woman with large curved horns and long flowing hair sits on a mossy stone platform beside a reflective pool, reaching out to touch glowing yellow cherry blossom branches that float in the air. In the background are ancient Greek temple ruins covered in green vines under a swirling dark blue and purple twilight sky. Black birds fly around while transparent bubbles containing silhouetted romantic couples drift through the scene, with pink petals and sparkles falling into the water that mirrors the entire composition.
